section.heading: Magistrate may direct search in his presence
section.html: Any Magistrate may direct a search to be made in his presence of any place for the search of which he is competent to issue a search-warrant
section.text: Any Magistrate may direct a search to be made in his presence of any place for the search of which he is competent to issue a search-warrant
